description: Checks one name across many endings at once: com, net, org, io, co, ai, app, dev, xyz, me, info and co.uk, or the endings given. Free names come first, cheapest first. Each result has domain, available (true, false or null), status (available, taken or unknown), checked_at, confirmed and by (registry, registrar, dns, dns_only or confirming); confirmed=false means the answer came from DNS and is still being confirmed. A free domain has price (first_year, renews, min_years, currency USD) and buy_url, a link to register that domain at a registrar. A taken domain has registrar, registered and expires when the registry publishes them.

endings.description: Optional endings to check, such as ["com", "io", "co.uk"]

name.description: The name without an ending, such as brightfield

name: search_name
title: Search a name across endings
